prompt: A money app turns dollars into euros with $e(d) = 0.8d$, then euros into yen with $y(e) = 150e$. Your friend ended up with $12000$ yen. How many dollars did you start with?
hint: You are running the chain BACKWARDS, so undo the LAST machine first — socks then shoes means shoes off first.

hints.text: You are running the chain BACKWARDS, so undo the LAST machine first — socks then shoes means shoes off first.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up: a machine doubles, then adds 3, giving 11. Undo backwards: $11 - 3 = 8$, then $8 \div 2 = 4$. Same idea — undo the last step first.
Undo the yen machine: $12000 \div 150 = 80$ euros. Now undo the euro machine.

explanation: Forward the order is dollars $\to$ euros $\to$ yen.
Backward you undo in reverse: yen $\to$ euros first.

alternativeExplanations.title: Guess and check forward
steps: Then $150 \times 80 = 12000$ yen — exactly the amount your friend has.
